title: Masseter
extract:
The Masseter is  Grendel's signature greatsword with a distinctive crankshaft-shaped blade. In addition to grinding its foes into chunks with every swing, Grendel becomes unshakable when he readies a heavy attack.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Rending Crane and  Noble Cadence (Conclave only) stance.
Melee Stance slams without the full slam visual, such as those from  Cleaving Whirlwind's Sundered Tusk combo, have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo and have the ability to crit.
Melee stance slams with the full slam visual have the ability to crit, but do not have their damage multiplied by Melee Combo.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Third highest status chance of all heavy blades, behind  Gram Prime and  Masseter Prime.
Tied with the  Galatine and  Galatine Prime for the second fastest attack speed of all heavy blades, behind  Masseter Prime.
Highest slam attack radius of all weapons.

Acquisition
The Masseter's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Notes
When wielded by  Grendel, he is immune to crowd control procs during Heavy Attacks.
Has a uniquely large slam radius compared to other weapons of the same class.
Under Heavy Blades, the Melee Combo dependent damage multiplier and ability to deal critical hits on Melee Stance 'mini' slams is only shared by  Gram Prime,  Masseter Prime and  Paracesis
On other weapons, these hits only deal minimal damage as they are unaffected by mods other than  Seismic Wave.

Trivia
The masseter muscle is one of four muscles responsible for chewing.
Keeping with  Grendel's design being inspired by Oni, the Masseter's design is based on the Kanabō, a studded, two-handed club used by samurai. The cumbersome nature of the kanabō resulted in the weapon being associated with oni due to their great strength.
The close associations between oni and kanabō in Japanese culture have resulted in the phrase oni-ni-kanabō (鬼に金棒, "[giving a] kanabō to oni") to describe giving further advantages to a powerful opponent, which may be the basis for Grendel's immunity to crowd control effects while preparing a heavy attack with the Masseter.
When the Masseter is used to perform an attack, the blade's rotation will ramp up for a short period of time and eventually slow back to idle speed.
Manually guarding will lock the Masseter's blade in place until guarding is released, regardless of current speed.
